name: Headset Battery
author: Jason Cromwell
description: Wireless headset battery level in the bar, with a panel showing charge, volume, mic and device details. Works with any headset UPower can see.

barWidget.description: Wireless headset battery level and details

schema.label: Low battery warning (%)
schema.description: On battery, the widget turns the warning color at or below this level.

schema.label: Hold last level while charging
schema.description: Some headsets, such as the Corsair Void series, report a false level while plugged in. When on, the widget shows the last reading taken on battery until you unplug.
